essence: These named powers are to be worshipped together as part of the prescribed arrangement.
Khadga, Ravana, and Vallabha are to be installed starting at the eastern petal and proceeding leftward.
Vainayaki, Camunda, and Maheshi should be worshipped in the quarters.
The pair Raudra and Pingala, fearsome like cremation fire, are to be included.
Mahakala and the entire Kumbhakarna are to be placed in the hair.
